name: Authorization-first Candidate Generation
mechanism: Propagates user and agent identity into the search backend and applies tenant, resource, field, purpose, time and version predicates before candidate materialization.
use_when: The corpus contains protected or tenant-scoped data
Caches rerankers or models must never observe unauthorized candidates
avoid_when: All corpus content is intentionally public
The backend can filter only after returning raw candidates
expected_effects: Reduced confused-deputy and cross-tenant disclosure risk
Consistent authorization across retrieval and context expansion
failure_modes: Stale ACL replicas grant revoked access
Parent or neighbor expansion crosses a boundary
Caches omit identity or policy version from keys
required_evals: parent neighbor and cache boundary tests
